title: Senior Backend Engineer - Subscriptions
description:
What You'll Do 
Design, build, and maintain scalable Java services that power Spotify's merchandising platform and help listeners discover and upgrade to Premium. Work with your team to develop backend systems, APIs, and data models using Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Partner with product managers, data scientists, and engineers to turn complex challenges into practical, scalable solutions. Build and improve data pipelines that support experimentation, recommendation logic, and machine learning applications. Shape technical decisions that improve system reliability, performance, and maintainability as our platform grows. Take ownership of production services, using monitoring, observability, and continuous improvement to deliver reliable experiences. Share knowledge through code reviews, technical discussions, and collaboration to help your team learn and grow.
Who You Are
You have 5+ years of experience developing backend services with Java. You have a solid understanding of computer science fundamentals and experience building distributed systems at scale. You're experienced in designing, deploying, and maintaining cloud-based services using platforms such as GCP or AWS. You know how to design APIs and work with partners to turn product needs into reliable technical solutions. You understand what it takes to operate high-traffic services, including monitoring, performance optimization, and reliability. You enjoy collaborating across disciplines, sharing ideas, and taking ownership of projects from design through delivery. You value feedback, continuous learning, and finding better ways to build systems and work together. You're familiar with technologies such as gRPC, BigQuery, Bigtable, content management system integrations, or machine learning applications.
Where You'll Be
This role is based in London, UK. We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.
Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.
 
At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.
